parsed.name: Arbin电池循环测试仪
parsed.description: 多通道电池循环测试仪，用于对电池或电芯进行充放电循环测试、通道状态监测和性能评估，常用于电池研发与测试实验室。
parsed.description_en: A multi-channel battery cycler used for charge-discharge cycling tests, channel status monitoring, and performance evaluation of batteries or cells in battery R&D and testing laboratories.
